summary: This topic details the comprehensive process of collecting fees from students, including searching for students, viewing their fee demands, applying concessions, selecting installments, and processing various payment modes.
steps: Navigate to the 'Collect Fee' option from the top menu or within a student's profile.
Search for the student using their name, registration number, father's name, or phone number.
Verify the student's details displayed on the interface.
Click on the student's record to open the fee collection section.
Review the student's personal details and their current fee demand.
If applicable, click the 'Concession' option to apply a fee concession (see 'Applying and Managing Student Concessions' topic).
Select the desired installments for payment (default is the first, but you can select all or specific ones).
Optionally, manually enter a partial amount if the student is not paying the full installment. The system will allocate this amount based on the predefined fee head sequence.
If 'Cash' or 'Cheque' is selected, enter the reference number, payment date, and any optional remarks.
If 'Online' is selected, the system will redirect to the integrated payment gateway (e.g., Razorpay).
A fee receipt will be generated upon successful collection.
business_rules: Partial payments are allocated based on a predefined fee head sequence (e.g., Security first, then Tuition Fee, etc.).
Concession groups must be pre-configured in the system to be applied.
important_notes: There are multiple entry points for fee collection, including a dedicated 'Collect Fee' option and an 'Online Fee' option.
The ERP is integrated with payment gateways like Razorpay for online transactions.
The fee receipt format is customizable to suit office requirements.
